activity.notes: Nasser became president of Egypt on 23 June 1956. This Activity ends immediately before the Egypt-Syria union formed the United Arab Republic on 22 February 1958; his UAR presidency is recorded separately.

sources.title: Gamal Abdel Nasser — Egypt State Information Service
sources.citation_text: Egypt's State Information Service records Nasser becoming president on 23 June 1956 and the formation of the United Arab Republic on 22 February 1958.
